mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in fewer than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 320.0 in the prior month signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 1350 and RSAFS < 720000.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 and UNRATE declines > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 in the prior month indicates weakening supply capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth (PAYEMS) falling below 150,000 persons per month signals weakening labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 150000.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime (HOUST > 1350 and RSAFS > 720000), housing and retail sales growth drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1350 and RSAFS > 720000.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level (GDPC1) below 23000 billion dollars indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 23000.
